apps.title: Apps
apps.description: App Store IDs (numbers like 6737164760) or app names to search for. Names resolve to the top search result.

maxReviewsPerApp.title: Max reviews per app per country
maxReviewsPerApp.description: Apple exposes up to 500 most-recent reviews per app per storefront (10 pages of 50).

includeAppInfo.title: Also output app metadata
includeAppInfo.description: Adds one record per app with name, developer, price, average rating, rating count, current version and release notes.
